name: NotebookLM
freeTierNote: Standard free tier: 100 notebooks, 50 sources/notebook (now called Gemini Notebook).

pricingTiers.name: Google AI Plus (bundled)
pricingTiers.note: Monthly billing only; no standalone subscription

priceBand: Free tier; Google AI Plus bundle $4.99/mo (Nov 2026)
bestFor: Grounding answers in PDFs, notes, and sources you upload
skipIf: You want open web search or a coding agent
keyFeatures: Answers strictly grounded in uploaded sources
Inline page citations to your PDFs & notes
limitations: Not for open-web search or coding
summary: A notebook that answers from your sources. The opposite of a hallucinating general chat.
body: NotebookLM (now branded Gemini Notebook) is the rare Google AI product with a crisp job: put documents in, ask questions, get answers tied to those pages. Audio overviews are a bonus, not the product. It will not replace Perplexity for the live web or Cursor for a repo. Students and researchers who drown in PDFs get generous limits on the free tier, while higher quotas bundle into Google AI Plus/Pro rather than a standalone subscription.
notes: Keep sensitive docs out unless your Workspace policy allows it
Pair with Gemini for the rest of Google, not as a second Gemini
